objects.txt: Mirefen. Turn back if you value dry feet.
Saltbrook. Fishmonger east. Docks south. Mind the tide.
Oakheart Mine. Copper and tin. Bring a pickaxe.
Oakheart. Bank north. Smithy south. Road east to Aldermere.
Dunhollow. Deep mines beyond. Watch your step.
Aldermere. Market ahead. Keep to the north. Road south to Oakheart.
Blightfort. Beyond here the Warden keeps no peace.
